crossRefs.note: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to…
Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin…
I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but…
and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;
translations.bsb: For when I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not merely command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices,
translations.kjv: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
translations.asv: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt-offerings or sacrifices:
